description: Use when a name is a CNAME and the person asks where it leads. Returns each hop with its target and TTL, and how it ends: addresses, none, a resolver failure, NXDOMAIN (dangling), a loop, or an inside name.

name.description: The name to follow, e.g. www.example.com. Also accepted as "domain"; a URL is reduced to its host.

name: alias_chain
title: Follow a CNAME chain
